caption: The drawing depicts a round wooden frame with a prominent brown coloration and golden-yellow highlights along its inner edge and in floral embellishments at four equidistant points around the circumference. The frame's surface is shown with shading to indicate a three-dimensional, curved profile. Surrounding the main, colored depiction is a lightly outlined square that contains the frame. To the lower left outside the frame, there is a small pencil sketch of a floral and leaf motif matching the ornamental details on the frame. To the lower right, there is a small schematic side-view outline of the frame's profile. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the artist’s signature “M.G. Prignam” is written in the bottom left corner outside the square, while the text “1/2 to 1” appears near the bottom right corner.
title: Picture Frame
